long_biography.plain_text:
Ann Scrutton’s voluntary work has included the presidency of the United Wards Club of the City of London, which promotes the City’s history and civic traditions. She also spent more than twenty years on the Chigwell fundraising committee for the Children’s Society.

Scrutton trained as a radiographer at Westminster Hospital, qualifying in 1969, and worked in several London hospitals. After leaving the NHS, she retrained as a Montessori teacher. Her voluntary service also included more than fifteen years as secretary and membership secretary of the local arts society in Harlow.
